name: Bisq
description: Detached OpenPGP verified vs fingerprints hardcoded in client + bundled keys; downloads+verifies, manual install.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Bisq's retrieved desktop updater downloads a platform installer plus detached OpenPGP signatures and signer material from bisq.network and bundled resources. It matches the signing-key identifier to candidate keys and verifies the installer bytes with Bouncy Castle; the documented flow then leaves installation for the user.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study release; the evidence does not independently establish release-server behavior or full-key fingerprint policy beyond the checked-in identifiers.

original_evidence.text: | Bisq | github.com/bisq-network/bisq | Java/JavaFX desktop | Y | notify (P2P network "update alert" triggers a dialog; user must click Download; nothing runs unattended) | N (downloads installer + sig, PGP-verifies it, opens the OS Downloads folder, then shuts Bisq down so the user installs manually — explicitly "a downloader and verifier, not an automatic installer" per project docs) | https (bisq.network domain, OS trust store, standard TLS, no additional pinning) | N/A (no separate manifest; each installer ships with its own detached `.asc` signature; `signingkey.asc` names which signer fingerprint was used) | signature (detached OpenPGP/RSA signature, verified via BouncyCastle `PGPSignature.verify()`) | pinned-in-binary (hardcoded fingerprints `FINGER_PRINT_GABRIEL_BERNARD`/`FINGER_PRINT_ALEJANDRO_GARCIA`/`FINGER_PRINT_HENRIK_JANNSEN`, matched against bundled local key resources under `/keys/*.asc`; the same keys are also re-fetched from `https://bisq.network/pubkey/` as a redundant cross-check, not as the sole trust anchor) | docs/in-app-update-download.md:1-30; desktop/src/main/java/bisq/desktop/main/overlays/windows/downloadupdate/BisqInstaller.java:60-64 (pinned fingerprints+URLs), :148-211 (`verifySignature`), :284-316 (`getKeyFileDescriptors`/`getLocalKeyFileDescriptor` bundled resource keys) |
